newsitem.title: UK: EBRD raises Croat bank's credit line to DM 40mln.
newsitem.headline: EBRD raises Croat bank's credit line to DM 40mln.

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) has extended by 20 million German marks the initial 20 million mark credit line to Croatia's Dalmatinska Banka, the EBRD said in a statement.
The extension was a response to continuing demand from small and medium-sized companies for term financing, it said.

"The existing credit line to Dalmatinska Banka has played a major role in the development of Croatian agribusiness, bringing vital financing to this sector," said Hans-Christian Jacobsen, Director of EBRD's Agribusiness team.
Of the initial credit line, 18 million marks has already been committed, with Dalmatinska Banka funding 11 projects.
The extended credit line will be devoted to projects in the chemicals, trade and tourism sectors, in addition to agribusiness, the statement said.
